outcome: Select and rebut verification delegation approaches, integrate an offline result contract checker and distributable adoption guidance through the existing process adapter
non_goals: Install all external tools or mandate Quint for every task
Implement a model checker, parser engine, cryptographic primitive or policy language
Change capability/policy/baseline schemas or weaken delivery gates
Merge or delete SDLC and Architecture Vault

acceptance.statement: Result validation accepts only JSON satisfying a repository-owned Draft 2020-12 schema; mismatch exits 1, invalid input or unsupported reference exits 2 without fetching remote resources
A wrapper retains producer failures and validates fresh results; logical rejection, unknown version and wrong subject cannot pass verify/delivery in integration fixtures
Existing process capabilities and discovery remain functional; packaged usage, seed and local Skills explain the three ownership patterns and rejection of mandatory common envelopes
ADR and operating guidance compare independent implementation, specialist tools and language delegation including counterarguments, bounded adoption and remaining guarantees

reasons: New validation boundary and distributed operator guidance; existing process and delivery contracts remain unchanged

constraints: Use existing jsonschema evaluator, offline references only
Keep policy, baseline and enabled capabilities unchanged
Register no unrequested project-specific verification commands
